headline.en: Carry useful session context into the next restart.
headline.zh: 让有用的会话上下文延续到下次启动。

sub.en: automem extracts user messages and file references from a session transcript, stores them locally, and retrieves relevant summaries through a short-lived CLI.
sub.zh: automem 从会话记录提取用户消息和文件引用，在本地保存，再通过短生命周期 CLI 检索相关摘要。

body.en: Capture and recall need no key or daemon.
body.zh: 捕获与召回无需密钥或守护进程。

body.en: Extracted text and paths remain in JSONL.
body.zh: 抽取的文字与路径保存在 JSONL 中。

body.en: install --dry-run shows hook or wrapper changes.
body.zh: install --dry-run 展示 hook 或包装器修改。

title.en: Run it on a complete example

note.en: Capture examples/session.transcript, recall its constructor decision and inspect counters in a temporary store. Python 3 drives the isolated example.
note.zh: 在临时库捕获 examples/session.transcript，召回构造函数决策并检查计数；示例由 Python 3 驱动。

steps.label: Recorded run
steps.body: Offline capture, lexical recall and stored/injected statistics using the bundled transcript in a temporary store; no agent hook is installed.

also make sure the old constructor keeps working for callers we don't own

files: auth.py
1 stored, 1 injected

  total injections: 1
  by agent:

body.en: Capture examples/session.transcript, recall its constructor decision and inspect counters in a temporary store. Python 3 drives the isolated example.
body.zh: 在临时库捕获 examples/session.transcript，召回构造函数决策并检查计数；示例由 Python 3 驱动。

steps.code:
git clone https://github.com/SuperMarioYL/automem.git
cd automem
go build ./cmd/automem

limitations.en: Recall is lexical, not semantic embedding search. It scans the stored records and may miss paraphrases.
limitations.zh: 召回使用词汇匹配，不是语义嵌入检索；它扫描已有记录，可能漏掉改写表达。

limitations.en: The injected counter records that recall surfaced a memory; it does not prove the model used it or improved its answer.
limitations.zh: injected 计数表示 recall 输出过该记忆，不证明模型实际利用它或改善回答。

limitations.en: The Aider wrapper is marked unverified in the source. sync and team are stubs, with no hosted backend provided here.
limitations.zh: 源码将 Aider 包装器标为未验证；sync 与 team 是占位命令，此处未提供托管后端。

body.en: Repeatedly pasting the same project decisions is tedious. Save the source transcript once and recall matching context when you need it; no embedding service or model request is needed for the local path.
body.zh: 反复粘贴同一项目决策很繁琐。保存会话后，在需要时召回匹配内容；本地流程无需嵌入服务或模型请求。

body.en: capture parses transcripts and extracts trailing user messages, paths and diff information into a JSONL store. recall ranks records by weighted lexical overlap and exponential recency decay, then optionally increments injected counters. install can write Claude Code hooks or an Aider wrapper that invoke the same CLI.
body.zh: capture 解析会话，将末尾用户消息、路径及 diff 信息写入 JSONL。recall 按加权词汇重合与指数时间衰减排序，并可增加 injected 计数。install 可写入调用同一 CLI 的 Claude Code hook 或 Aider 包装器。

body.en: capture parses transcripts and extracts trailing user messages, paths and diff information into a JSONL store. recall ranks records by weighted lexical overlap and exponential recency decay, then optionally increments injected counters. install can write Claude Code hooks or an Aider wrapper that invoke the same CLI.
body.zh: capture 解析会话，将末尾用户消息、路径及 diff 信息写入 JSONL。recall 按加权词汇重合与指数时间衰减排序，并可增加 injected 计数。install 可写入调用同一 CLI 的 Claude Code hook 或 Aider 包装器。

body.en: Choose the input and output route that matches your workflow. The local example below exercises the stated subset.
body.zh: 根据工作流选择输入与输出路径。本文本地示例验证其中明确说明的子流程。

body.en: AUTOMEM_DIR defaults to ~/.automem and owns store.jsonl. AUTOMEM_HOME redirects installation paths, while AUTOMEM_BIN selects the executable written into hooks. recall --top sets result count; --no-mark previews without updating counters. install --dry-run previews config edits. Review that preview before running install, which changes your agent configuration.
body.zh: AUTOMEM_DIR 默认 ~/.automem，管理 store.jsonl。AUTOMEM_HOME 改变安装路径，AUTOMEM_BIN 指定写入 hook 的可执行文件。recall --top 设置返回数；--no-mark 只预览、不更新计数。install --dry-run 预览配置修改；确认预览后再运行会修改 Agent 配置的 install。

body.en: Run these commands from the repository root after installation. Replace paths for your own data.
body.zh: 安装后在仓库根目录运行以下命令；处理自己的数据时替换相应路径。

details.code:
go run ./cmd/automem capture --agent claude-code examples/session.transcript
go run ./cmd/automem recall --top 3 --no-mark "auth.py constructor"
go run ./cmd/automem stats
go run ./cmd/automem install --dry-run
